items.message: Rust `run_command` detection checks `"[[bin]]" in cargo` as a substring match on raw TOML text.
`go run .` is bound when `main.go` exists at the root, but the description acknowledges that Go commands under `cmd/` are not found.

The `servable` predicate treats any non-empty `provision_commands` as meaning the repository can be served, which suppresses the decline message even when no test, lint, build or run binding is possible.

The `test_every_advertised_manifest_is_one_detection_actually_reads` test asserts `facts.summary()` is non-empty, but `pom.xml` alone (no wrapper) sets `stack = 'jvm'` and produces no bindable command — so `summary()` may be empty for it.
